protocol.training: held-source-out; all changed observations only; no invariance duplication
protocol.natural_training: held-source-out within 73 natural items; separate from challenge
protocol.wl: 16 rounds, uniform initial colors, graph histogram per round, no IDs/positional features
protocol.scope: 12 strong pairs are a template-limited proof of concept; no broad graph-intelligence claim
protocol.gnn_limit: Anonymous 1-WL-equivalent message passing cannot distinguish the strong pairs
protocol.intervals: source bootstrap descriptive; pair Wilson approximate; neither validates population generalization

strong-change.answer_balance: Stored A/B label frequencies need not match. Primary metrics are unordered Both and symmetric endpoint accuracy; endpoint symmetrization gives equal arm weights without creating new observations or inflating the pair/source denominator.
